source.prices: Nine stage-qualified 950DT/PR development windows; development/validation/hc_post_timing23/calibrate.py and results/v0.23/hc-timing/parameters.json. DMA intercepts in core cycles; slopes in cycles/byte. No kernel-duration regression.
source.dma_override: The dominant first residual read and output write give effective reference bytes per cycle = reciprocal of first_res and write slopes. If supplied, target MTE GB/s is per AIV; ratio uses target GB/s / GHz in bytes per cycle. Applies only to byte-dependent terms. Neither reference is an independently measured physical port peak.
source.ub: Source reserves two BF16 x, residual and output queue slots and two FP32 post/comb slots plus one FP32 accumulator. 4096 tile × 52 bytes, plus 2 × (32-byte rounded post + 64-byte comb). Excludes runtime-reserved space.
source.scope: Dense BF16 payload / FP32 coefficients; width must be divisible by 16. A nonzero final tile shorter than 64 elements is excluded after both 950 endpoints failed the numerical golden at a 16-element tail. A different ISA, compiler revision, tiling, residency or bank arrangement requires new evidence.
